title: Ephemeral diagnostic attachment store and playbook pre-seeder to speed on-call triage
author: Priya Menon
description: Summary: Add an ephemeral attachment store for incident-bundles (minidumps, short trace slices, sanitized log excerpts) plus a playbook pre-seeder that runs lightweight telemetry queries in the background when an alert is routed to a responder. Motivation: On-call reaction time is dominated by two things: locating relevant traces/log snippets and picking a first-action playbook. This PR implements a small, opt-in attachment cache with TTL and a separate pre-seeder that enqueues a set of curated queries for the alert context so responders see prepopulated results and playbook suggestions within seconds. Design: - Ephemeral attachment store: small S3-like bucket abstraction backed by Redis metadata and object storage in the private bucket; attachments have a 1h default TTL, automatic sanitizers to remove PII, and a signed short-lived URL exposed in the incident-bundle. - Playbook pre-seeder: ruleset-based query templates (per-service + alert-signature) that execute asynchronously at low priority; results are stored in the attachment store as JSON blobs and referenced by the incident summary. - Opt-in controls: per-team toggles in oncall settings, and a lightweight rate limiter per-project to avoid heavy query storms. - Safety and compliance: sanitizer runs on upload, we emit audit events for every attachment and query execution. Implementation notes: - New modules: src/attachments/ (store, sanitizer, signer), src/preseed/ (rules engine, scheduler), api handlers: src/handlers/attachment_routes.py and src/handlers/preseed_hooks.py - DB: metadata persisted in existing incidents Postgres table with small addition (ephemeral_attachments jsonb, preseed_jobs jsonb). Migration included. - Telemetry: add metrics: incidentbot.attachment.uploads, .sanitizer.errors, .preseed.jobs.started, .preseed.jobs.latency, .preseed.cache.hit. - Backward compatibility: incident payloads without preseed metadata behave unchanged; attachments are optional. Testing & CI: - Unit tests for sanitizer, signer, preseed rule matching (tests/test_attachments.py, tests/test_preseed.py). - Integration test that simulates an alert and verifies preseeded results are visible in the incident summary within 3s. - Load smoke that verifies preseed queries are scheduled at low priority (ci job preseed-smoke). Checklist: - [x] Core store + signer + sanitizer implemented - [x] Playbook rules engine + scheduler implemented - [x] DB migration + simple rollback script - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs for feature and admin toggle - [x] Added metrics and dashboards link - [x] Feature gated behind per-team opt-in - [x] Manual verification on staging with synthetic alerts Backwards compatibility and rollout: Feature is behind a per-org feature flag (off by default). Ops can enable per-team; default TTL 1h can be configured. Rollout plan: opt-in to a pilot org, monitor metrics, then enable gradually. Risks & mitigations: - Query storm: preseed scheduler uses priority queues and rate-limits per-project; immediate mitigation is to reduce per-team concurrency. - PII leakage: sanitizer covers common patterns and we added an allowlist/denylist; we run additional audits during pilot. Release notes: Adds an opt-in ephemeral attachment store and playbook pre-seeding for faster on-call triage. Admins can control via oncall settings. See docs link in changed files. Related: ENG-7891 (pilot), SUP-312 (customer request).

review_comments: Erik Tan: Please add a metric for preseed cache hits and a counter for sanitizer rejections. We need these for pilot dashboards.

release_notes: Opt-in ephemeral attachment caching and playbook pre-seeding for faster triage. Configurable TTL, per-team opt-in, sanitizer and audit events. Pilot with ENG-7891.
notes_for_ops: To enable for a team: - Toggle feature flag in Admin > Oncall > Ephemeral Attachments - Monitor metrics: incidentbot.preseed.jobs.started, incidentbot.preseed.cache.hit, incidentbot.attachment.uploads - If preseed job latency rises, reduce REDWOOD_PRESEED_CONCURRENCY or lower per-team concurrency via Admin UI - Rollback: toggle feature flag off; migration includes a rollback SQL to clear ephemeral metadata.
